vb_textbox.text: I was advised to try and follow a pattern of always selecting similar, so if you get a good reward from a large hat, then click a large hat the next time. I followed this advice, but didn't feel confident this was a correct pattern so tried to find my own. I first tried looking for a pattern between colours and hat size etc, but couldn't find anything consistent. Then I tried always selecting the left button. I felt this was quite succesful on providing quite a success in larger mushrooms, but wanted to try something else to check. So I then tried alternating, from left to right and I felt this was the most succesful of all my attempts. So although I don't have a definite answer to the code, I would suggest simply alternating left to right, as for me, it seemed to produce the best results.
